title: (BUG) clippy type_complexity in jscontact-types lib test
description: crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1735 declares `let cases: &[(&str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool)] = &[...]` which fails `-D clippy::type_complexity` on Rust 1.95. Fix: introduce a `type CaseRow = (&'static str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);` alias above the test (or `#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]` on the test fn with a justification comment). Pre-existing — does not block JMAP-j7pa.1 work but breaks workspace-wide `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` gate.
close_reason: Triage 2026-10-19 at 9fdbbbcf, FIXED (3-skeptic check 3/3 upheld): crate-jmap-jscontact-types/src/lib.rs:1807 now reads `type Case<'a> = (&'a str, serde_json::Value, fn(&AnniversaryDate) -> bool);` and lib.rs:1808 reads `let cases: &[Case<'_>] = &[...]`. That is the type-alias fix the bead proposed, and it was added in commit 0519a717 ("ci: fix fmt, clippy, doc, typos and deny"). The code sits inside test fn `anniversary_date_unknown_object_with_recognised_at_type_loses_variant_identity` (lib.rs:1787). The bead has no parent. Checks run at HEAD 9fdbbbcf with rustc 1.99.1: `cargo clippy -p jmap-jscontact-types --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` exited 0 with no warnings. `cargo test -p jmap-jscontact-types --lib anniversary_date_unknown_object_with_recognised_at_type` gave 1 passed, 0 failed.
